condition.asset: BetterHelp disclosures of health information: HIPAA enforcement by HHS or the DOJ

condition.criterion: TRUE on the date HHS Office for Civil Rights or the Department of Justice announces a HIPAA enforcement action (civil money penalty, resolution agreement or criminal charge) against BetterHelp or Teladoc Health over the disclosures described in the FTC complaint.
